name: signal-surface-html
description: Interactive HTML decision surfaces generated from editable temporary source projects.

interface.longDescription: Signal Surface HTML creates temporary, self-contained HTML artifacts for plans, reviews, feature explainers, presentations, risks, roadmaps, migrations, and research. Each artifact is compiled from a lean source project so iteration edits structured source files, not disposable HTML output. Use $s2-html as the short router; literal /s2-html is treated as a fallback text trigger.
defaultPrompt: $s2-html turn this plan into an editable HTML review.
$s2-html create an approval board for these findings.
$s2-html explain this feature as a walkthrough.
